spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they're already behind on a couple of bills

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, you’re speaking with Sam. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Leanne Kowalski. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and honestly, I’m really unhappy with how hard it’s been to get anyone to sort this out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been such a frustrating experience, Leanne. I’ll take ownership of it and look into what we can do. Before I discuss any account details, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see the card payment you mean. Could you tell me the amount and the date you noticed?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s £186.40 to Northstar Gadgets on the 22nd of October. I’ve never bought anything from them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll record this as a disputed card payment, and I’m also logging this as a complaint about your experience with us. Your complaint reference is TB-740216.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good, because I’ve spent ages on this already. I’m already behind on a couple of bills, and this is making things worse.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’re dealing with that on top of this, Leanne. I can refer you to our Financial Support team, who can talk through your circumstances and options, including whether extra time with payments may be available.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll make that referral today. I’ll also send the disputed payment details to our card disputes team for review. I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but I’ll keep track of both actions.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint and the card payment information today, and I’ll send your Financial Support referral as well. Our complaints team will send you a full written response within 15 business days. I’ll personally call you by 5pm tomorrow to confirm the referrals have been sent and update you on the next steps.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Leanne. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll be in touch tomorrow as agreed. Goodbye.
